caption: Search results show matching items under their rundown

steps: move the mouse away from the list
notes: Search is full text over rundown titles and the items' title, content and additional notes (items_data). The matching items render as a nested item list (rundown_items inner hits) under each rundown row. The search only runs on Enter. Make sure the search index has caught up with the seeded items before the shot.
skip: The search cannot find rundown items on this stack (superdesk-client-core develop 7e08bc457 with superdesk-core 3.6.0.dev0): the client sends the search as source.query.bool.must[query_string], but RundownsService.get (apps/rundowns/rundowns.py) only adds the nested items_data query with inner_hits for source.query.filtered.query.query_string or the q parameter. So only rundown titles match and no item rows are nested under a rundown. GET /api/rundowns?q=election does return matching_items, so the server side works; the client query shape does not reach it.
